label: a1-choice unit: high when (upcoming) choice is a1; raised at D1 by prior loss and a1->S2
explanation: Raw reset gate r15 tracks the agent choice of a1 vs a2. Largest term: this trial choice is a1 (+0.25 on all phases; FUTURE at D1/GO, i.e. the upcoming choice). At D1 it is further raised after an unrewarded previous trial (+0.20) and after a previous a1 that reached S2 (rare, +0.14); at GO a previous loss adds +0.09; at D2 reaching S1 adds +0.14 and a previous a1 a little (+0.04). Value output does not matter (value decile reference 0.01); this trial reward and trials since reversal add nothing. Test R^2 beyond timing 0.85 (dev 0.85) vs all ceiling 0.95. Observed-only version (D2 action==1, GO model_act==1 i.e. the agent own computed policy argmax, D1 prev_action/prev_reward/prev_state, D2 state, GO prev_reward, D2 prev_action; 8 terms) scores test 0.80, so the future dependence is mostly the agent own upcoming choice, which it already represents by GO.

issues: Minor: the 'previous a1 at D2 (+0.04)' term is fragile. When the action term is split by phase (D1 0.22, GO 0.27, D2 0.30), its weight falls to 0.01. The single action weight of +0.25 is also an average across phases, not a constant.

Minor: the D1 a1->S2 effect really is specific to a1. Adding prev a2->S2 gets weight -0.02, and a generic prev_state==2 term scores slightly lower. Replacing the a1->S2 term with plain prev_action==1 gives a test R^2 of 0.83, down from 0.846.

The future-action dependence is real. Restricting action==1 to D2 drops test R^2 to 0.53. Observed-only proxies recover most of it: tanh(choice logit) at D1/GO gives 0.785, model_act gives 0.72. The 0.80 observed-only figure in the explanation is plausible, and the label correctly marks the choice as upcoming.

Remaining errors are moderate, not a large systematic class. D1 after a2 S1 r is over-predicted by 0.107. D1 after a1 S1 u and after a1 S2 r are under-predicted by about 0.065. D1 during long rewarded a1 S1 streaks is over-predicted by about 0.2 in the worst windows. Adding a last_is('a2 S1 r') term or a two-trial reward-streak term each gains at most 0.006 in test R^2 (0.852 / 0.849).
The reference scores check out: value decile 0.01, this reward 0.00, trials since reversal 0.00. The recorded terms reproduce a test R^2 of 0.846.
